# Orbiah Education

> Shaping Futures Through Education.

Orbiah Education is a global education company delivering high-quality learning through physical schools, digital platforms, and community outreach programs. Its long-term vision is to make education more accessible across borders through international-style, multilingual learning in Arabic, English, and French.

## Our system

### Orbiah Education

The main education initiative serving children, young people, and adults through accessible education and future-ready learning.

### Orbiah Schools

A future physical-learning concept with structured classrooms, qualified teachers, and a safe learning environment. Physical school opportunities are opening soon.

### Orbiah Academy

An online learning system for children, teenagers, and adults. Learners can learn from anywhere through live and recorded lessons, flexible digital learning, personalized support, and structured courses.

### Orbiah Hope

A future charity and scholarship initiative focused on sponsoring children, improving access to education, and creating community impact.

## Orbiah Academy levels

- Orbiah Kids: fun, engaging early education
- Orbiah Teens: academic and future preparation
- Orbiah Adults: skills, growth, and lifelong learning

## Subjects

- English
- Arabic
- French
- Quran
- Coding
- School support
